tweet.text:
We were investigating Wedgewood for faking their data and emailed them for comment this morning, ahead of publishing the findings tomorrow. They are trying to cover up their fraud with the "we were doing a social experiment" excuse. 
Full story here: https://blog.fiftyplusone.news/p/fiftyplusone-just-caught-a-pollster
